This will reduce their administrative burden and give them more legal certainty","source_section":"Introduction"}]},{"label":"regulatory_supervision","confidence":0.8,"evidence":[{"quote":"Signatory Taskforce, chaired by the AI Office, to facilitate a coherent application of the Code.","source_section":"Signatory Taskforce"}]}],"implementation_notes":"The GPAI Code of Practice is a voluntary compliance tool endorsed by the European Commission and AI Board as adequate for demonstrating compliance with AI Act obligations (Articles 53 and 55). It is organized in three chapters: Transparency, Copyright, and Safety and Security. The Safety and Security chapter applies only to providers of GPAI models with systemic risk. Signatories sign voluntarily but gain legal certainty benefit. The code does not itself impose binding obligations; the underlying AI Act does.","confidence":0.92}
